A '''holo-program''' was a document produced to accompany the production of "[[For the Want of an Empire]]," a play produced at the [[Iscera theater|theater]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iscera]]. It contained information on the play, including the names of the performers such as [[Jaalib Brandl]].
